checks: Two production files only. Reuse existing Eigen strided maps and Accelerate DSYRK, Welford means, canonical pair replay and the existing bounded panel; no new kernel, library, allocation class or thread.

Negative F canonical uses ordered scalar means/products. Admit stride0=-1 and stride1>=T, using ordered C-style certificates, never the positive-F reduction tree. Positive C/F and all root eligibility remain unchanged.
Eight-feature traversal reuses the same helper/expression and storage. Every feature keeps ascending logical observations; no arithmetic reassociation or threshold/tolerance change.
Source scan and panel addressing keep both terms signed. Bounded shape and INT_MAX leading cap bound products; no abs(PTRDIFF_MIN). Native source/output canaries cover padded descending C and F.

Transport is unchanged: negative F is already packed to positive F. The initial 18 process failures used a wrong local-layout exact-diagonal reference; tests now check the actual worker canonical plus original full tolerance. No production IPC repair or tolerance relaxation.
Expanded existing tests cover local replay, nonfinite/range rejection, zero/error recovery, interval/padding, single/thread/inline/shared, C/F/auto, snapshots, budgets and OFF fallback.

Two separately reported 12-case six-round same-CPU comparisons, retaining prior independently owned results and all negative cases. Final memory uses 12 fresh children. No composition of samples across comparison batches.
Source/wheel/extension/worker identity checked for all 77 native inputs. Formula and Excel budgets unchanged; only historical recalculated snapshot verified.
limits: Not whole-engine performance acceptance; the goal remains active. Scaled and dense replay still use canonical and remain materially slower than warmed NJIT.

Initial negative-F admission added about 67.5 ms (6.2%) to 32769x256 dense replay; final tiling saves about 9 ms of that in its own comparison. This is speculative-work cost, not a few-KB/ms exception.

1024/2048 time is still behind NJIT in several cases; absolute few-ms changes are recorded, not standalone vetoes. The final 4096 paired case is about 9% faster than NI, not a claimed order-of-magnitude NI gain.
Final memory compares first library candidate versus tiled candidate and NJIT. Original scalar build memory is not newly measured here; library scratch is an existing real cost, not declared free.
Any untracked frees and RSS/probe limits remain in validation.json. Vendor reserve is an estimate, not a hard allocator bound. ASan/UBSan do not instrument vendor libraries, detect_leaks=0.
No fresh Microsoft Excel recalculation, platform integration, deployment, commit or push. Explicit LAPACK eigendecomposition contract still awaits user decision.
